name: pi-deepseek-pricing-by-time
description: Time-of-day-aware DeepSeek cost accounting for pi: re-prices every DeepSeek assistant message with the official peak/off-peak rates in effect at the message's own UTC timestamp, so session totals, the footer, the statusline cost segment, and exports match
